messages:
sam_s: Quick heads-up — we're rolling a small pricing table tweak (v2.1) tonight that tightens commit buckets for Dedicated GPU tiers and clarifies burst pricing. Not a headline change but affects quoting math. @leah_pricing, scope and effective time?
leah_pricing: scope = dedicated-prod GPU SKUs only (g4/g5-equivalent); effective 2026-04-01 00:00 UTC. We renamed the buckets and moved a few customers from the 10k->25k commit into a 15k intermediate bucket. Docs: https://redwood.internal/pricing/v2.1 (internal).
leah_pricing: Grandfathering: any signed contract or active POC with a proposal date before 2026-04-01 gets a 90-day grandfather window. After that we expect the new buckets. Exceptions via deal desk as usual.
maria_fin: FYI — revenue recognition impact should be minimal for renewals. POCs with credits: we need a note on the quote that credits are one-time and not part of the commit baseline.
devon_legal: please add a one-line addendum template for clients who want the old bucket beyond the grandfather window. I can draft a short SOW amendment.
ryan_eng: quick question — does this change any of the POC pricing templates in HubSpot/Quote? We have a few live POCs that assume the larger 25k bucket.
leah_pricing: @ryan_eng yes — update template id `quotes/poc-template-v1` to `poc-template-v1.1` with the new bucket mapping. Snippet: "commit_buckets": [10000,15000,25000] replaces [10000,25000].
ryan_eng: thanks — I'll patch the template and push a note to the SE playbook.
sam_s: Sales ask: for any active deal where the customer asked for the 25k pricing but signed before 4/1, can we keep them on the old math during the 90-day window? I assume yes per grandfathering, but want deal desk confirmation before quoting.
deal-desk-bot: To request an exception, tag @leah_pricing + attach signed proposal and select reason code: `legacy-commit-grandfather`. SLA: 24h review.
leah_pricing: correct — grandfather window keeps the old effective rates for existing signed deals/POCs. For anything requiring extension beyond 90 days, create a deal-desk ticket and cc @devon_legal.
maria_fin: also note — any credit that reduced effective commit must be documented separately so we don't undercount committed ARR. Use the credit line item `one_time_credit` on the quote.
devon_legal: I'll prepare the addendum template and post to the legal snippets doc later today.
sam_s: ok — action items: (1) @ryan_eng update templates, (2) @leah_pricing publish v2.1 internal note + change log, (3) sales to flag affected docs and use deal-desk-bot for exceptions.
ryan_eng: started on the template patch, will push by EOD.
leah_pricing: publishing changelog now. Internal changelog entry: "v2.1 — 2026-04-01 — intermediate 15k commit bucket; 90-day grandfathering for signed deals/POCs; update poc-template-v1.1."
sam_s: perfect. ping here when changelog live and when HubSpot template updated. :thumbsup:
leah_pricing: changelog posted and template id updated in the internal tracker. Link: https://redwood.internal/pricing/changelog#v2.1
ryan_eng: HubSpot template updated, pushed to staging. I'll create a short note for SEs on what to say to customers.
sam_s: thanks team — rolling out comms to customers tomorrow morning, internal FAQ to follow. :rocket:
